NEET PG 2026 Registration Opens: Your Essential Guide to Application and Key Updates

The highly anticipated NEET PG 2026 registration window has officially opened, marking a critical period for medical graduates aspiring to pursue postgraduate specializations across India. The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) commenced the application process on July 1, 2026, inviting eligible candidates to apply for MD, MS, and PG Diploma courses. This year brings with it some significant changes, and it's crucial for every aspirant to be well-informed to ensure a smooth application process.

With the examination tentatively scheduled for August 30, 2026, the race to secure a coveted seat in top medical institutions has officially begun. Read on for a comprehensive breakdown of everything you need to know about NEET PG 2026 registration.

Important Dates to Remember

Mark your calendars with these crucial dates for NEET PG 2026:

Event Date
NEET PG 2026 Registration Start Date July 1, 2026
NEET PG 2026 Registration End Date July 21, 2026 (11:55 PM)
Information Bulletin Availability July 1, 2026 (4:00 PM)
Test City Intimation Slip Release August 11, 2026
Admit Card Release Around August 27, 2026 (2-3 weeks before exam)
NEET PG 2026 Examination Date August 30, 2026
NEET PG 2026 Result Declaration By September 30, 2026

Who Can Apply? NEET PG 2026 Eligibility Criteria

To be eligible for NEET PG 2026, candidates must fulfill the following essential requirements:

1. Educational Qualification
Candidates must possess an MBBS degree or a provisional MBBS pass certificate recognized under the National Medical Commission (NMC) Act, 2019, and the Post Graduate Medical Education Regulations, 2023, from a recognized institution.
2. Compulsory Internship
A one-year compulsory rotatory internship must be completed on or before September 30, 2026. Those completing their internship after this date will not be eligible.
3. Registration Certificate
Applicants must hold a permanent or provisional registration certificate issued by the NMC, the former Medical Council of India (MCI), or a State Medical Council (SMC).
4. Nationality & Foreign Medical Graduates (FMGs)
Indian citizens, NRIs, OCIs, PIOs, and foreign nationals are eligible. Foreign medical graduates must qualify the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) and possess a valid FMGE pass certificate. They must also complete their internship by the specified date and register with MCI/SMC.
5. Age and Attempt Limit
There is no upper age limit or restriction on the number of attempts for NEET PG 2026.

Step-by-Step: How to Register for NEET PG 2026

Follow these steps to successfully submit your NEET PG 2026 application:

1. Visit the Official NBEMS Website
Navigate to `natboard.edu.in`.
2. Register for NEET PG 2026
Click on the NEET PG Exam 2026 registration link and provide the necessary details to register.
3. Fill Out the Application Form
Log in with your generated credentials and accurately complete all sections of the application form.
4. Upload Required Documents
Upload scanned copies of your passport-size photograph (not older than three months), signature, MBBS degree, and internship completion certificate, adhering strictly to the prescribed image upload guidelines. Non-compliant images may lead to rejection.
5. Pay the Application Fee
Make the payment online via credit/debit card or net banking. The application fee is ₹3500 for General, OBC, and EWS categories, and ₹2500 for SC, ST, and PwD categories.
6. Review and Submit
Carefully review all the details entered before final submission. Download and print the confirmation page for your records.

Crucial Changes for NEET PG 2026: What You Need to Know

NBEMS has introduced significant updates this year that all aspirants must be aware of:

No First-Come, First-Served for Test Cities: One of the most important changes is the abolishment of the "first-come, first-served" rule for test city allocation. Early submission of the application form will no longer guarantee a preferred test city or centre. Candidates are advised not to rush their application.

Test State Selection Instead of Cities: Instead of choosing preferred test cities, candidates will now select three preferred test states. The first preference must align with the correspondence state provided in the application, and the other two should be neighbouring states.

Mandatory Aadhaar-Based Authentication: For the first time, Aadhaar-based authentication and verification will be implemented during the exam process. Candidates must ensure their Aadhaar is unlocked and avoid applying any substances on their fingers that might interfere with biometric verification.

Correspondence Address & State Preferences Are Final: The correspondence address and preferred test states cannot be changed once the application form is submitted, even during the edit window.

NEET PG 2026 Exam Pattern at a Glance

✅ **Mode:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)

✅ **Total Questions:** 180 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)

✅ **Marking Scheme:** +4 marks for each correct answer; -1 mark for every incorrect answer.

✅ **Qualifying Percentile:** 50th percentile for General/EWS, 40th percentile for SC/ST/OBC, and 45th percentile for General-PwD categories.

Final Thoughts and Preparation

With the registration window now open and the exam date set for August 30, 2026, it's time to intensify your preparation. The official information bulletin, available on natboard.edu.in, contains comprehensive details on the syllabus, exam pattern, and other critical instructions. Ensure you go through it thoroughly before applying.

Don't Miss Out!

The deadline for NEET PG 2026 registration is July 21, 2026. Complete your application diligently and embark on your journey towards a specialized medical career.
